verzen.tekst: Wisdom guarded to the end the first formed father of the world, who was created alone,
verzen.html: Wisdom guarded to the end the first formed father of the world, who was created alone,

verzen.tekst: and gave him strength to rule over all things.
verzen.html: and gave him strength to rule over all things.

verzen.tekst: But when an unrighteous man fell away from her in his anger,
verzen.html: But when an unrighteous man fell away from her in his anger,

verzen.tekst: When for his cause the earth was drowning with a flood,
verzen.html: When for his cause the earth was drowning with a flood,

verzen.tekst: Moreover, when nations consenting together in wickedness had been confounded,
verzen.html: Moreover, when nations consenting together in wickedness had been confounded,

verzen.tekst: While the ungodly were perishing, wisdom delivered a righteous man,
verzen.html: While the ungodly were perishing, wisdom delivered a righteous man,

verzen.tekst: To whose wickedness a smoking waste still witnesses,
verzen.html: To whose wickedness a smoking waste still witnesses,

verzen.tekst: For having passed wisdom by,
verzen.html: For having passed wisdom by,

verzen.tekst: but wisdom delivered those who waited on her out of troubles.
verzen.html: but wisdom delivered those who waited on her out of troubles.

verzen.tekst: When a righteous man was a fugitive from a brother’s wrath, wisdom guided him in straight paths.
verzen.html: When a righteous man was a fugitive from a brother’s wrath, wisdom guided him in straight paths.

verzen.tekst: When in their covetousness men dealt harshly with him,
verzen.html: When in their covetousness men dealt harshly with him,

verzen.tekst: She guarded him from enemies,
verzen.html: She guarded him from enemies,

verzen.tekst: When a righteous man was sold, wisdom didn’t forsake him,
verzen.html: When a righteous man was sold, wisdom didn’t forsake him,

verzen.tekst: and in bonds she didn’t depart from him,
verzen.html: and in bonds she didn’t depart from him,

verzen.tekst: Wisdom delivered a holy people and a blameless seed from a nation of oppressors.
verzen.html: Wisdom delivered a holy people and a blameless seed from a nation of oppressors.

verzen.tekst: She entered into the soul of a servant of the Lord,
verzen.html: She entered into the soul of a servant of the Lord,

verzen.tekst: She rendered to holy men a reward of their toils.
verzen.html: She rendered to holy men a reward of their toils.

verzen.tekst: She brought them over the Red sea,
verzen.html: She brought them over the Red sea,

verzen.tekst: but she drowned their enemies,
verzen.html: but she drowned their enemies,

verzen.tekst: Therefore the righteous plundered the ungodly,
verzen.html: Therefore the righteous plundered the ungodly,

verzen.tekst: because wisdom opened the mouth of the mute,
verzen.html: because wisdom opened the mouth of the mute,
